profile.name: 文件监视器
profile.description: 用于监视实验计算机上指定目录中的文件变化并记录日志的软件工具，常用于跟踪成像或数据采集过程中生成的数据文件。
profile.description_en: A software utility that monitors file changes in a specified directory and records logs, commonly used in laboratories to track files generated during imaging or data acquisition.
